subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, inheritance, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the change intentionally processes and retains speech from messages that did not invoke the bot, making this a product/security decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Define Scoped Discord Policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait For Shared Media-History Policy
options.body: Keep the issue as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until maintainers define cross-channel media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline Silent Transcription
options.body: Keep current mention-gated behavior if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should not be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define Scoped Discord Policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent current-main owner for the exact Discord preflight files, though product/security direction may need broader maintainer input.
